description:
Jaehyuk gets a part-time job experimenting with adult products to fill his empty wallet. However, this dog role-playing experience kit never leaves Jae-hyuk's ears. Jae-hyuk, who had a falling out in high school, appears in front of Jae-hyuk, who is wandering around unable to go home.

---

**Original Webtoon:**  
[MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000052723), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13414799), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/good_my_boy), [Lezhin*](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/good_my)

**Official Translations:**  
[Japanese](https://honto.jp/ebook/pd-series_C-MBJ-21782-9-608899X.html)

---

**Lezhin combined [Love Finger](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=10865723526) and [Good Dog, My Boy](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=54941078955) under the name "Good My Toys (굿 마이 토이즈)".*
